name: p67_battery_native_event

ownership.argument: Borrowed live battery event and immutable original LvxBattery class 0x2cd198dc. Forward original class explicitly; event and target remain native-owned. During idle snapshot capture forward all native drawing; otherwise a derived per-instance shim may replace DRAW_MAIN only.
ownership.return_value: No ownership transfer; event and target pointers must not escape dispatch.

side_effects: Native base-event dispatch and battery draw-task submission

provenance.source: Exact .043 read-only native ABI audit: class+12 at 0x2cd198dc points to 0x0c4c22cd; draw 0x0c4c1d68 receives lv_event_t*.

notes: DRAW_MAIN=24, DELETE=36. Native callback calls the base event with the original class. PREPROCESS stop-processing cannot suppress class drawing in this build. Restricted static interoperability record only; no public or hardware approval.
